PowerShell($start = Get-Date; while \(\(Get-Date\) - $start -lt [TimeSpan]::FromMinutes\(4\)\) { Start-Sleep 15; $tail = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\diag_out.txt" -Tail 5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($tail -match "STAGE 2 PASSED|STAGE 2 FAILED|EXCEPTION"\) { Write-Host "DONE:"; $tail; break } elseif \($tail\) { Write-Host "Still running... last line: $\($tail[-1]\)" } })
